decisions.rationale: This is the same independently reproduced joined defect as S2-A1-F1: fresh Windows worktrees convert the four canonical LF seed files to CRLF, causing exact manifest validation to fail before target creation. A seed-scoped LF checkout rule is smaller and safer than platform-specific digest replacement or validator weakening. Restoring the mandatory target entrypoint outweighs the negligible configuration and focused-verification cost.
decisions.smallest_fix: Enforce LF working-tree bytes only for firmware_acceptance/seed/*, retain the canonical manifest digests, prove the rule in a fresh worktree, then rerun only A2's failed materialization/substitution IDs and any directly dependent A1 seed check.
